A premium app-store-ready app icon for a kids health superhero app called VitaHero. The design must have a polished, modern gaming/fitness app aesthetic.

Background: Deep rich midnight navy-to-slate gradient (#0B1121 to #1E293B), opaque full-bleed fill. Subtle radial energy glow in the center behind the emblem (soft emerald green halo).

Central focal symbol: A sleek, modern superhero shield emblem centered prominently. The shield shape is bold and geometric — a classic shield silhouette with clean angular facets. The shield body is rendered in vibrant emerald green (#10B981) with a metallic polished finish. A thin gold (#FACC15) border outlines the shield for a premium look.

Inside the shield: A glowing stylized heart shape combined with a subtle lightning-bolt element intersecting the heart, rendered in warm golden-amber (#F59E0B) with a soft white inner glow. The heart+bolt fusion symbolizes health and heroic energy.

Style: Clean vector art, sleek silhouette, app-store quality. Subtle specular highlights on the shield to give it depth. No text, no letters, no device frames, no rounded corner mask. The shield should fill roughly 60% of the canvas, leaving breathing room. The overall feel should be confident, heroic, polished, and friendly enough for kids while premium enough for adults to trust.
